manifest.name: Voice Input
manifest.description: 입력창에 마이크 버튼을 추가합니다. 말한 내용을 OpenAI 호환 음성 인식 API(OpenAI, Groq, Mistral, 로컬 Whisper 등)로 받아써서 입력창에 넣습니다. / Adds a microphone button to the composer and dictates through any OpenAI-compatible transcription API.

settings.label: 서버 주소 (API base)
settings.description: 음성 인식 서버의 origin입니다(예: https://api.openai.com). https 화면에서는 https 주소(또는 localhost)만 쓸 수 있고, 스킴을 생략하면 https입니다. / On an https page use https (or localhost).

settings.label: 전사 경로 (Transcription path)
settings.description: /로 시작하는 경로만 씁니다. 비우면 /v1/audio/transcriptions입니다. Groq는 /openai/v1/audio/transcriptions입니다. / Path only, starting with /.

settings.label: API 키 (API key)
settings.description: 서버가 요구하는 키입니다. Authorization: Bearer 헤더로만 보내며, 이 기기에만 평문으로 저장되고 내보내기에서는 제외됩니다. / Sent only as a Bearer header; stored in plain text on this device only.

settings.label: 모델 (Model)
settings.description: 받아쓰기 모델 이름입니다(예: gpt-transcribe). OpenAI, Groq, Mistral 등은 필수입니다. 비우면 보내지 않아 서버 기본값을 씁니다. / Model name; most hosted services require one.

settings.label: 말하는 언어 (Language)
settings.description: ISO 639-1 코드입니다(예: ko, en, ja). 비우면 보내지 않아 서버가 자동 감지합니다. gpt-transcribe는 자동으로 languages로 보냅니다. / Empty lets the server detect it.

settings.label: 단축키 동작 (Shortcut mode)
settings.description: both: 짧게 누르면 시작/정지, 길게 누르면 누르는 동안 녹음(0.3초 기준). toggle: 누를 때마다 시작/정지. hold: 누르고 있는 동안만. / Tap toggles, hold to talk (0.3 s), or either alone.

options.label: 누르는 동안 녹음 / Hold to talk

components.VoiceButton:
<script module>
	// Pure helpers for VoiceButton.svelte. scripts/build.mjs inlines this file into the component's <script module>
// (a trusted component can import only `pipaya`, `svelte*` and sibling .svelte files), and the tests import it directly.
// Keep it free of DOM, network and storage access.

const MAX_RECORD_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000;
const MIN_RECORD_MS = 400;
const MIN_BLOB_BYTES = 800;
const UPLOAD_TIMEOUT_MS = 60 * 1000;

// Preference order. Chrome/Firefox/Edge make webm or ogg (opus), Safari makes mp4. The services listed in the README
// accept webm and m4a, so the browser's own format is uploaded as is (no conversion).
const MIME_CANDIDATES = ['audio/webm;codecs=opus', 'audio/webm', 'audio/mp4', 'audio/ogg;codecs=opus', 'audio/ogg'];

function pickMimeType(isSupported) {
  for (const type of MIME_CANDIDATES) {
    try { if (isSupported(type)) return type; } catch { /* try the next one */ }
  }
  return '';
}

function baseMime(type) {
  return String(type || '').split(';')[0].trim().toLowerCase();
}

function extensionFor(type) {
  switch (baseMime(type)) {
    case 'audio/webm': return 'webm';
    case 'audio/mp4': case 'audio/x-m4a': case 'audio/aac': return 'm4a';
    case 'audio/ogg': return 'ogg';
    case 'audio/wav': case 'audio/x-wav': case 'audio/wave': return 'wav';
    case 'audio/mpeg': return 'mp3';
    default: return 'webm';
  }
}

function formatTime(ms) {
  const total = Math.max(0, Math.floor(ms / 1000));
  return `${Math.floor(total / 60)}:${String(total % 60).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

// Append to what is already typed, separated by one space; never replace the draft.
function joinDraft(current, addition) {
  const add = String(addition ?? '').trim();
  const cur = String(current ?? '');
  if (!add) return cur;
  return cur.trim() ? `${cur.replace(/\s+$/, '')} ${add}` : add;
}

// The extension talks only to the transcription server (`apiBase`), never to the pipaya server. HTTPS matters in two
// places, and only there:
//  1. The microphone (`getUserMedia`) needs the page to be a secure context (checked by the component).
//  2. A page opened over https cannot call an `http://` server (mixed content), so on such a page a plain-http address is
//     refused. The exception is a loopback host (localhost, 127.0.0.1, [::1]): browsers treat these as trustworthy and let
//     an https page call them, which is what a Whisper server on the same machine needs. Private-network addresses are not
//     an exception here (see README).
// On a page that is not https (an http page, or localhost) a plain-http address is fine.
function isLoopbackHost(hostname) {
  const h = String(hostname ?? '').toLowerCase();
  return h === 'localhost' || h.endsWith('.localhost') || h === '[::1]' || /^127(?:\.\d{1,3}){3}$/.test(h);
}

// An address typed without a scheme (`api.example.com`, `localhost:8000`) is read as https://. The stored value is not
// changed; only the reading is. Anything that already has a scheme is left alone.
function withScheme(text) {
  const t = String(text ?? '').trim();
  if (!t || /^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:\/\//i.test(t)) return t;
  // `host:port` also looks like `scheme:path`, so only a `scheme://` counts as a scheme here; other `x:y` forms fall through
  // to URL() below and are rejected as malformed.
  if (/^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:(?!\d+(?:\/|$))/i.test(t)) return t;
  return `https://${t}`;
}

// Splits what the user typed into { origin, problem }. `problem` is '' (fine), 'needBase' (empty or not an origin:
// path, query, credentials, other scheme) or 'needHttps' (a well-formed http:// address, on an https page, that is not
// loopback). `pageProtocol` is `location.protocol` of the page ('https:' / 'http:' / ...); when it is left out the
// strict reading is used, as if the page were https. A missing scheme means https (see withScheme).
function checkBase(apiBase, pageProtocol = 'https:') {
  const text = withScheme(apiBase);
  if (!text) return { origin: '', problem: 'needBase' };
  let url;
  try { url = new URL(text); } catch { return { origin: '', problem: 'needBase' }; }
  if (url.protocol !== 'https:' && url.protocol !== 'http:') return { origin: '', problem: 'needBase' };
  if (url.username || url.password || url.search || url.hash || !/^\/*$/.test(url.pathname)) return { origin: '', problem: 'needBase' };
  if (url.protocol === 'http:' && pageProtocol === 'https:' && !isLoopbackHost(url.hostname)) return { origin: '', problem: 'needHttps' };
  return { origin: url.origin, problem: '' };
}

// The bare origin to send to, or '' when the setting must not be used (see checkBase).
function originOf(apiBase, pageProtocol = 'https:') {
  return checkBase(apiBase, pageProtocol).origin;
}

// The standard OpenAI-style route. It is only the default of the `transcribePath` setting; servers that mount
// the same API elsewhere (a prefix, a gateway route) change the setting instead of the code.
const DEFAULT_TRANSCRIBE_PATH = '/v1/audio/transcriptions';

// A request path only: starts with one `/`, no scheme, origin, query, fragment, `..`/`.` segments, backslashes,
// spaces or control characters. Empty means the default. Returns '' when the value is not acceptable.
function pathOf(transcribePath) {
  const text = transcribePath === undefined || transcribePath === null ? '' : String(transcribePath).trim();
  if (!text) return DEFAULT_TRANSCRIBE_PATH;
  if (text.length > 200 || !/^\/(?!\/)[A-Za-z0-9._~\-\/%:@!$&'()*+,;=]*$/.test(text)) return '';
  if (text.split('/').some((part) => part === '.' || part === '..' || /^(%2e)+$/i.test(part))) return '';
  return text;
}

// origin + path, or '' when either part is not acceptable (then nothing is sent).
function endpoint(apiBase, transcribePath, pageProtocol = 'https:') {
  const origin = originOf(apiBase, pageProtocol);
  const path = pathOf(transcribePath);
  if (!origin || !path) return '';
  try { if (new URL(origin + path).origin !== origin) return ''; } catch { return ''; }
  return origin + path;
}

function hostOf(apiBase) {
  try { return new URL(String(apiBase)).host; } catch { return String(apiBase ?? ''); }
}

// OpenAI's documentation says the model `gpt-transcribe` takes `languages` (a list) instead of the single `language`, and
// that both must not be sent together. Only that exact model name is treated this way (compared without case or
// surrounding spaces): its reference lists no other `gpt-transcribe-...` model, and every other model or service keeps `language`.
const usesLanguagesList = (model) => String(model ?? '').trim().toLowerCase() === 'gpt-transcribe';

// Only file, model and the language hint are sent. Optional extras some services support (prompt, context or keyword hints)
// are left to the server. An empty language sends neither field.
function buildForm(blob, { model, language }) {
  const form = new FormData();
  const type = baseMime(blob.type) || 'audio/webm';
  form.append('file', new File([blob], `voice.${extensionFor(type)}`, { type }));
  const m = String(model ?? '').trim();
  if (m) form.append('model', m);
  const l = String(language ?? '').trim();
  if (l) form.append(usesLanguagesList(m) ? 'languages[]' : 'language', l);
  return form;
}

class VoiceError extends Error {
  constructor(kind, status) {
    super(kind);
    this.kind = kind;
    this.status = status;
  }
}

// One upload. The key goes only into the Authorization header and never into a message or log.
// Throws VoiceError(kind) with kind in needBase | needHttps | badPath | notFound | aborted | timeout | network | badKey | rateLimited | tooBig | serverError | badResponse | empty.
async function transcribe({ fetchImpl, apiBase, transcribePath, pageProtocol = 'https:', apiKey, model, language, blob, timeoutMs = UPLOAD_TIMEOUT_MS, signal }) {
  const base = checkBase(apiBase, pageProtocol);
  if (base.problem) throw new VoiceError(base.problem);
  if (!pathOf(transcribePath)) throw new VoiceError('badPath');
  const control = new AbortController();
  let timedOut = false;
  const timer = setTimeout(() => { timedOut = true; control.abort(); }, timeoutMs);
  const onAbort = () => control.abort();
  if (signal) { if (signal.aborted) control.abort(); else signal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true }); }
  try {
    let response;
    try {
      response = await fetchImpl(endpoint(apiBase, transcribePath, pageProtocol), {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${apiKey}` },
        body: buildForm(blob, { model, language }),
        credentials: 'omit',
        referrerPolicy: 'no-referrer',
        redirect: 'error',
        signal: control.signal
      });
    } catch {
      throw new VoiceError(timedOut ? 'timeout' : control.signal.aborted ? 'aborted' : 'network');
    }
    if (!response.ok) throw new VoiceError(httpErrorKind(response.status), response.status);
    let body;
    try { body = await response.json(); } catch { throw new VoiceError(timedOut ? 'timeout' : control.signal.aborted ? 'aborted' : 'badResponse'); }
    if (typeof body?.text !== 'string') throw new VoiceError('badResponse');
    const text = body.text.trim();
    if (!text) throw new VoiceError('empty');
    return text;
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(timer);
    signal?.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
  }
}

function micErrorKind(error) {
  switch (error?.name) {
    case 'NotAllowedError': case 'PermissionDeniedError': case 'SecurityError': return 'micDenied';
    case 'NotFoundError': case 'DevicesNotFoundError': case 'OverconstrainedError': return 'noMic';
    case 'NotReadableError': case 'TrackStartError': case 'AbortError': return 'micBusy';
    default: return 'micFailed';
  }
}

function httpErrorKind(status) {
  if (status === 401 || status === 403) return 'badKey';
  if (status === 404 || status === 405) return 'notFound';
  if (status === 429) return 'rateLimited';
  if (status === 413) return 'tooBig';
  return 'serverError';
}

function message(lang, key, params = {}) {
  const table = STRINGS[String(lang || '').toLowerCase().startsWith('ko') ? 'ko' : 'en'];
  return String(table[key] ?? STRINGS.en[key] ?? key).replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (m, k) => (k in params ? String(params[k]) : m));
}

// ── keyboard shortcut ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// The combo is typed as text in pipaya's own notation: modifiers `Mod` (Ctrl, or ⌘ on macOS), `Alt`, `Shift`, then exactly one
// key: `Alt+M`, `Mod+Shift+K`, `Alt+Space`. There is no default: empty = none. The app (`shortcuts.register`) does the work of
// listening: it ignores IME composition and key repeat, lets its own shortcuts win, and tells a release from a blur. This
// only turns what was typed into the canonical form the app wants, and refuses what the app would refuse, so that one rule
// is shown to the user: the app needs Ctrl/⌘ or Alt plus one key (a lone F-key is refused too). A few keys the app keeps
// for itself (Esc, Enter, Tab, Backspace) are refused as well.
const SHORTCUT_MIN_HOLD_MS = 300;
const NAMED_KEYS = new Set(['Space', 'Enter', 'Tab', 'Backspace', 'Escape', 'Minus', 'Equal', 'Comma', 'Period', 'Slash', 'Backslash', 'Semicolon', 'Quote', 'Backquote', 'BracketLeft', 'BracketRight', 'ArrowUp', 'ArrowDown', 'ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight', 'Home', 'End', 'PageUp', 'PageDown', 'Insert', 'Delete']);
const MOD_NAMES = ['Mod', 'Alt', 'Shift'];

function isKeyName(k) {
  return /^[A-Z]$/.test(k) || /^[0-9]$/.test(k) || /^F([1-9]|1[0-9]|2[0-4])$/.test(k) || NAMED_KEYS.has(k);

					<span class="badge">{notice.short}</span>
					<span class="hint wide">{notice.text}</span>
					<button type="button" class="btn-cancel" onclick={clearNotice} aria-label={tr("cancel")} title={tr("cancel")}>
						<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18" /></svg>
					</button>
				</div>
			{/if}
		</div>
	{/if}
{/if}

<div class="vi" bind:this={root} data-state={phase}>
	<!-- Screen readers get the state once, in words. The visible timer ticks every second and stays out of the live region. -->
	<span class="sr" role="status" aria-live="polite">{phase === "recording" ? tr("recording") : phase === "transcribing" ? tr("transcribing") : notice ? notice.text : ""}</span>
	<span class="status">
		{#if phase === "recording"}
			<span class="chip live">
				<i class="dot" aria-hidden="true"></i><span class="txt" aria-hidden="true">{formatTime(elapsed)}</span>
				<button type="button" class="x" aria-label={tr("cancel")} title={tr("cancel")} onclick={() => stop("cancel")}>
					<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18" /></svg>
				</button>
			</span>
		{:else if phase === "transcribing"}
			<span class="chip" aria-hidden="true"><span class="txt">{tr("transcribingShort")}</span></span>
		{:else if notice}
			<span class="chip bad" title={notice.text} aria-hidden="true"><span class="txt">{notice.short}</span></span>
		{/if}
	</span>

	<button
		type="button"
		class="mic"
		class:rec={phase === "recording"}
		class:busy={busy}
		class:err={!!notice && phase === "idle"}
		class:unavailable={insecure}
		aria-disabled={insecure || undefined}
		aria-label={label}
		aria-pressed={phase === "recording"}
		title={tip}
		disabled={blocked}
		{onclick}
	>
		{#if phase === "recording"}
			<!-- a microphone with a recording dot: the app's own stop button is a square, and the two must not look alike -->
			<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 3a3 3 0 0 0-3 3v6a3 3 0 0 0 6 0V6a3 3 0 0 0-3-3z" /><path d="M19 11a7 7 0 0 1-14 0M12 18v3" /><circle class="solid" cx="18.5" cy="5.5" r="3" /></svg>
		{:else if busy}
			<svg class="spin" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 3a9 9 0 1 0 9 9" /></svg>
		{:else}
			<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 3a3 3 0 0 0-3 3v6a3 3 0 0 0 6 0V6a3 3 0 0 0-3-3z" /><path d="M19 11a7 7 0 0 1-14 0M12 18v3" /></svg>
		{/if}
	</button>
</div>

<style>
	/* Same family as the app's send control (SendControls .send / .stack .send.stop): a 38px round button, grey at rest, danger
	   tint while recording, solid pre-mixed colours instead of opacity when it cannot be used. Only the app's tokens are used.
	   The status chip opens to the left of the microphone, so the microphone stays beside the send control and the chip is
	   what gives way (its text is cut with an ellipsis) when the bar is narrow, never the send control. */
	/* The overlay fills the input area of `.box` (position: relative) and ends strictly above the bar
	   (`bottom: var(--bar, 48px)`), so all bar controls (attachments, model, send/stop, mic) remain
	   fully visible and directly clickable without any overlay blocking or blurring them.
	   The draft underneath stays faintly visible through the frosted glass effect. */
	.overlay {
		position: absolute;
		top: 0;
		left: 0;
		right: 0;
		bottom: var(--bar, 48px);
		z-index: 1;
		display: grid;
		place-items: center;
		overflow: hidden;
		padding: 4px 12px;
		box-sizing: border-box;
		border-top-left-radius: inherit;
		border-top-right-radius: inherit;
		border-bottom-left-radius: 0;
		border-bottom-right-radius: 0;
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-elev) 80%, transparent);
		backdrop-filter: blur(3px);
		pointer-events: none; /* background is click-through to draft */
	}
	.overlay .row {
		display: flex;
		align-items: center;
		justify-content: center;
		gap: 12px;
		min-width: 0;
		max-width: 100%;
		flex-wrap: nowrap;
	}
	.overlay .big {
		font-size: 22px;
		font-weight: 600;
		font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
		letter-spacing: 0.01em;
		color: var(--text);
		line-height: 1;
		flex: none;
	}
	.overlay .big.small {
		font-size: var(--fs-sm);
		font-weight: 500;
		color: var(--text-dim);
	}
	.overlay .hint {
		font-size: var(--fs-sm);
		color: var(--text-dim);
		white-space: nowrap;
		flex: none;
	}
	.overlay .hint.wide {
		font-size: var(--fs-xs);
		white-space: normal;
	}
	.overlay.rec .big {
		color: var(--danger);
	}
	.overlay .badge {
		display: inline-flex;
		align-items: center;
		flex: none;
		height: 24px;
		padding: 0 10px;
		border-radius: 999px;
		font-size: var(--fs-sm);
		background: var(--danger-soft);
		color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 80%, var(--text));
		box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 40%, transparent);
	}
	.overlay .spin {
		width: 18px;
		height: 18px;
		flex: none;
		fill: none;
		stroke: var(--text-dim);
		stroke-width: 2.1;
		stroke-linecap: round;
	}
	/* Waveform bars */
	.wave {
		display: flex;
		align-items: flex-end;
		justify-content: center;
		gap: 2px;
		flex: 0 1 180px;
		min-width: 44px;
		height: 28px;
	}
	.wave i {
		flex: 1 1 0;
		min-width: 2px;
		max-width: 6px;
		height: calc(10% + var(--l) * 90%);
		border-radius: 999px;
		background: var(--danger);
		opacity: 0.85;
		transition: height 90ms linear;
	}
	/* Overlay action buttons: explicitly interactive while overlay background passes clicks */
	.overlay .actions {
		display: inline-flex;
		align-items: center;
		gap: 4px;
		flex: none;
	}
	.overlay .btn-cancel,
	.overlay .btn-stop {
		pointer-events: auto;
		display: grid;
		place-items: center;
		border-radius: 50%;
		border: 0;
		cursor: pointer;
		user-select: none;
		touch-action: manipulation;
		transition:
			background var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-std),
			color var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-std),
			transform var(--motion-fast) var(--ease);
	}
	.overlay .btn-cancel {
		width: 28px;
		height: 28px;
		background: transparent;
		color: var(--text-dim);
	}
	.overlay .btn-cancel svg {
		width: 15px;
		height: 15px;
		fill: none;
		stroke: currentColor;
		stroke-width: 2.2;
		stroke-linecap: round;
	}
	.overlay .btn-cancel:hover {
		background: var(--bg-active);
		color: var(--text);
	}
	.overlay .btn-cancel:active {
		transform: scale(0.9);
	}
	.overlay .btn-stop {
		width: 32px;
		height: 32px;
		background: var(--danger-soft);
		color: var(--danger);
		box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 40%, transparent);
	}
	.overlay .btn-stop svg {
		width: 17px;
		height: 17px;
		fill: none;
		stroke: currentColor;
		stroke-width: 2.1;
		stroke-linecap: round;
		stroke-linejoin: round;
	}
	.overlay .btn-stop .solid {
		fill: currentColor;
		stroke: currentColor;
		stroke-width: 1;
	}
	.overlay .btn-stop:hover {
		background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 22%, transparent);
	}
	.overlay .btn-stop:active {
		transform: scale(0.9);
	}

	@media (max-width: 580px) {
		.overlay .hint { display: none; }
		.overlay .row { gap: 8px; }
		.overlay .big { font-size: 19px; }
		.wave { flex-basis: 110px; }
	}

	/* While the overlay is active, the compact status chip in the bar is hidden to avoid duplicate time displays. */
	:global([data-part="composer.box"][data-voice-overlay="active"]) .status {
		display: none;
	}

	.vi { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; flex: 0 1 auto; }
	.status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-width: 0; }
	.sr { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; margin: -1px; padding: 0; overflow: hidden; clip-path: inset(50%); white-space: nowrap; border: 0; }

	.mic {
		display: grid; place-items: center; flex: none; width: 38px; height: 38px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 50%;
		background: var(--bg-active); color: var(--text-faint); cursor: pointer;
		-webkit-touch-callout: none; user-select: none; touch-action: manipulation;
		transition: background var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-std), color var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-std), box-shadow var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-std), transform var(--motion-fast) var(--ease);
	}
	.mic svg { width: 19px; height: 19px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2.1; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
	.mic:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--border-strong); color: var(--text); }
	.mic:active:not(:disabled) { transform: scale(0.9); }
	.mic .solid { fill: currentColor; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1; }
	/* recording: the app's stop button look */
	.mic.rec, .mic.rec:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--danger-soft); color: var(--danger); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 40%, transparent); }
	.mic.rec:hover:not(:disabled) { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 22%, transparent); }
	.mic.err { color: var(--danger); }
	/* Not a real disabled state when the page is not https: the button stays clickable so pressing it explains why. */
	.mic.unavailable:not(.rec) { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-faint) 60%, var(--bg-active)); }
	.mic.unavailable:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--bg-active); color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-faint) 60%, var(--bg-active)); }
	/* cannot be used right now (offline, working): solid pre-mixed colours, like the send control when it is disabled */
	.mic:disabled { cursor: default; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-faint) 60%, var(--bg-active)); }
	.mic.busy:disabled { color: var(--text-dim); }
	.spin { animation: vi-spin 0.9s linear infinite; }

	/* status chip: a pill, 28px high (the buttons are 38px), padded 12px so the text never touches the edge */
	.chip {
		flex: 0 1 auto; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; max-width: 12em; height: 28px; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 0 12px;
		border-radius: 999px; background: var(--bg-active); color: var(--text-dim);
		font-size: var(--fs-sm); line-height: 1; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap;
	}
	.chip .txt { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
	/* the text is a little darker than --danger so it reads at 4.5:1 on the light theme too */
	.chip.live, .chip.bad { background: var(--danger-soft); color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 80%, var(--text)); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 40%, transparent); }
	/* the cancel button lives inside the recording chip, so they read as one control */
	.chip.live { padding: 0 3px 0 11px; }
	.dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; flex: none; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--danger); animation: vi-pulse 1.2s ease-in-out infinite; }
	.x { display: grid; place-items: center; flex: none; width: 24px; height: 24px; margin-left: 2px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: transparent; color: inherit; cursor: pointer; transition: background var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-std); }
	.x svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2.2; stroke-linecap: round; }
	.x:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 18%, transparent); }
	.x:focus-visible { outline-offset: 0; }

	@keyframes vi-spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
	@keyframes vi-pulse { 50% { opacity: 0.35; } }
	@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .spin, .dot { animation: none; } .mic, .x { transition: none; } .mic:active:not(:disabled) { transform: none; } .wave i { transition: none; } }
	@media (max-width: 480px) { .chip { max-width: 8em; padding: 0 10px; font-size: var(--fs-xs); } .chip.live { padding: 0 3px 0 10px; } }
</style>
